sources_reverified_live.title: Sec. 37.15 — Reporting Obligations; Licensing
sources_reverified_live.confirms: Reporting duty; annual March 1 deadline (buildings <10 units from March 1, 2023); license on substantial compliance; suspension/prospective restoration; no individual-owner or two-unit exemption.

sources_reverified_live.title: The Rent Board Housing Inventory
sources_reverified_live.confirms: All owners required to report; free; license auto-generated for non-owner-occupied units; current license on effective date; license need not accompany notice; March 1 deadline.

sources_reverified_live.title: Rent Board Rules and Regulations, Part XIII — §13.14 Licensing
sources_reverified_live.confirms: Effective date (not service date) governs licensing validity; unlicensed increase null and void; banking rights preserved; applies on/after July 1, 2022 (March 1, 2023 for buildings <10 units).

sources_reverified_live.title: Notification of 2027 Rent Board Fee and Housing Inventory Requirements
sources_reverified_live.confirms: 2027 fee exemption deadline Monday December 14, 2026; Housing Inventory deadline March 1, 2027; fee exemption and inventory reporting mutually non-substituting; unlicensed increases null and void.

sources_reverified_live.title: 42 U.S.C. §3604 — Fair Housing Act
sources_reverified_live.confirms: Primary federal statute text; discrimination in rental terms/conditions/privileges and notices prohibited; federal protected classes.

sources_reverified_live.title: Notice of Owner Noncompliance with Housing Inventory
sources_reverified_live.confirms: Portal address/APN license lookup; unlicensed increase null and void; Tenant Petition for Unlawful Rent Increase (after) / Tenant Summary Petition (before).

sources_reverified_live.title: 2024 Rental Housing Finance Survey (RHFS) release CB26-TPS.12
sources_reverified_live.confirms: Released February 19, 2026; national property/mortgage/ownership-entity structure; does not measure SF 94122 rate-increase behavior (supports H-11 blank).
